Page Evidence v0.9.0 brings together the features added since v0.8.0 on September 23, 2026.

## What's new

- Renamed Site Signal to Page Evidence, preserving the legacy CLI alias and configuration support.
- Added Umbraco Engage analytics alongside GSC, GA4 and Matomo.
- Added change digests, cache inspection, explicit evidence refresh and weekly action reviews.
- Added local Ahrefs Organic Keywords CSV import with normalization, diagnostics and profile-scoped persistence.
- Added provider-neutral search opportunities through CLI and MCP, with provenance, contradictory evidence and missing-evidence cues.
- CREATE, CONSOLIDATE and semantic EXPAND require explicit evidence-backed assessments. The opportunity engine makes no model calls.

## Fixes

- Improved query fetching while preserving response compatibility.
- Filtered instruction-like search queries from agent-facing output and closed a question-output bypass.
- Corrected Matomo bounce-rate normalization and missing-provider-setting checks.

External search evidence currently uses manually supplied Ahrefs exports. DataForSEO integration is not included.

## Validation

- TypeScript build passed.
- All 142 tests passed across 12 test files.
- Package dry-run passed.
